note: Sanitized shapes of the Claude Code 2.1.308 SessionStart transcript records that the receipt adapter session-start-hook-success-v1 reads (#1916). Measured on darwin/arm64; 2.1.308 writes the hook_additional_context record after the hook_success records, and adds record fields (rendered, renderedRole) the adapter does not read. Placeholders in <angle brackets> are filled by the test harness; no captured ids, paths or tokens. mergedContext is that context record exactly as 2.1.308 writes it when a second SessionStart hook also gives context (measured 08-11 in a real profile): one record per SessionStart that merges every hook's context, key order and field types as measured, neutral content.
